title: ThoughtOrganizer training example
description: One line of datasets/synthetic.jsonl, datasets/real_holdout.jsonl, or datasets/gold/gold_vX.Y.jsonl. This is a machine-checkable mirror of training/DATASET_SPEC.md's 'Data contract' section and training/prepare_data.py's validate_record() — those two are authoritative; if this schema and the Python validator ever disagree, the Python validator wins, since that's what actually gates training. Regenerate/update this file if prepare_data.py's validation logic changes.

input.description: Raw scattered thoughts, as the user would actually type them.

narrative.description: Coherent flowing narrative covering the same content as 'input', same meaning and tone.

bullets.description: Short key points extracted from 'input'. Typically 3-7; may be empty.

action_items.description: Concrete tasks/next steps mentioned in 'input'. Empty array when input has none — never invented.

difficulty.description: Optional annotation, not read by prepare_data.py. Curriculum-defined difficulty tier.

category.description: Optional annotation, not read by prepare_data.py. The one specific recovery skill this example teaches — see docs/datasets/CATEGORY_REFERENCE.md.
